pairs.evidence: src/components/layout/SidebarL2/useSidebarL2.ts:25 The L2 sidebar is built from the module registry (getSubModulesForCategory), so it navigates application modules, not a set of documentation topics; a case-insensitive search of src/components/layout/ for topic, sitemap, includeDrafts and lastReviewed found nothing, and src/app/ has no docs route, so the subject's precondition (documentation published as a product surface) does not hold here.
